article_title: Afghan women tell the BBC their lives are unrecognisable after five years of Taliban rule

tasks.prompt: What is the article's central message?
options: Afghan women's daily lives and rights have been transformed by severe restrictions during five years of Taliban rule
Afghanistan has introduced equal access to education and employment
Women interviewed by the BBC said their lives had changed very little
The article focuses only on military events outside Afghanistan
tasks.correct_answer: Afghan women's daily lives and rights have been transformed by severe restrictions during five years of Taliban rule
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מביאה עדויות של נשים שחייהן וזכויותיהן השתנו באופן קיצוני בעקבות מגבלות הטליבאן.

tasks.prompt: Which restriction is described in the article?
options: Girls and women receive free university education
Girls are barred from secondary and higher education
Women may travel anywhere without conditions
All former female employees have returned to work
tasks.correct_answer: Girls are barred from secondary and higher education
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת את האיסור על לימודי בנות בחינוך העל־יסודי ועל לימודי נשים באוניברסיטאות.

tasks.prompt: What does “barred” mean in the context of girls and education?
options: Given financial support
Invited to participate
Prevented or prohibited
Asked to teach younger students
tasks.explanation_hebrew: barred פירושו שנמנעה מהן האפשרות או שנאסר עליהן להשתתף.

tasks.prompt: Why did some women speak cautiously or anonymously to the BBC?
options: They feared reprisals for criticising the authorities
They could not remember events before 2021
They were preparing to join the government
They wanted to advertise private businesses
tasks.correct_answer: They feared reprisals for criticising the authorities
tasks.explanation_hebrew: נשים חששו מתגובות ענישה אם זהותן או ביקורתן על השלטון ייחשפו.

tasks.prompt: How can restrictions on female education also damage healthcare over time?
options: They immediately increase the number of trained female doctors
They make hospitals unnecessary
They reduce the future supply of trained women in a society where female patients may need female staff
They guarantee lower maternal mortality
tasks.correct_answer: They reduce the future supply of trained women in a society where female patients may need female staff
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כאשר נערות ונשים אינן יכולות ללמוד, מספר הרופאות ואנשי המקצוע בעתיד מצטמצם, דווקא כשנשים מתקשות לקבל טיפול מגברים.

tasks.prompt: What does “eroding” mean when the article says rights are being eroded?
options: Gradually weakened or taken away
Officially celebrated
Quickly translated
Protected by a coalition
tasks.explanation_hebrew: eroding מתאר תהליך הדרגתי של שחיקה והחלשה של זכויות.

tasks.prompt: Identify three ways Taliban rules have restricted the daily lives of Afghan women and girls.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלוש מגבלות קונקרטיות המתוארות בכתבה.
expected_points: Girls are barred from secondary education
Women are excluded from higher education
Many women are restricted from employment or public life
Travel may require a male chaperone
Access to healthcare has become harder
Rules constrain clothing, movement and public participation

tasks.prompt: Summarise how five years of Taliban rule have affected Afghan women, using social and economic examples from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול זכויות, חינוך או עבודה, חופש תנועה, עוני ובריאות, וכן את קולות הנשים המרואיינות.
expected_points: Women described their former lives as unrecognisable
Education and employment opportunities have been sharply reduced
Movement and participation in public life are restricted
Poverty and economic hardship have intensified the pressure on families
Healthcare access and maternal health are threatened
Women continue to call for rights and international solidarity

tasks.prompt: Why can restrictions on work and movement deepen poverty for an entire family, not only for women?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את שרשרת הסיבה והתוצאה בין אובדן הכנסה, הגבלת תנועה, תלות כלכלית והישרדות המשפחה.
expected_points: A household loses potential income when women cannot work
Movement rules make it harder to reach jobs, markets or services
Families become more dependent on fewer earners
Economic pressure can force harmful survival choices
Poverty also reduces access to food, education and healthcare

tasks.prompt: Using the article, explain three actions the international community could take to support Afghan women without ignoring the risks they face.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע שלוש פעולות מבוססות כתבה ולהתייחס לבטיחות, חינוך, בריאות, סיוע או השמעת קולן של נשים.
expected_points: Fund safe education opportunities for girls and women
Support women-led aid and healthcare organisations
Protect the identities and security of women who speak out
Include Afghan women in decisions about their country's future
Maintain humanitarian assistance for families facing poverty
Press for the removal of restrictions while monitoring possible reprisals
